    Introduction to Bazzite¶

    • Installing Bazzite

      From desktop/laptops,
      Framework 13/16, home theater PC setups to a multitude of handhelds:

      • Steam Deck (and OLED)
      • Lenovo Legion Go
      • Asus ROG Ally (and X)
      • GPD Handhelds
      • OneXPlayer Handhelds
      • Ayn Handhelds
      • Ayaneo Handhelds

    • Running Windows Games

      Bazzite comes bundled with Steam* and Lutris.

      It is also compatible with other tools as well:

      • Heroic for Epic Games, GOG, and Amazon Games integration.
      • Bottles for general-purpose Windows applications.
      • ...And more!

      * Desktop images require enabling Proton for all Steam games.

    • Installing Software

      Order reflects the recommendation degree.

      1. Flatpak for graphical apps.
      2. ujust to use Bazzite tailored installers.
      3. Homebrew for command-line apps.
      4. Quadlet for hosting services on your host.
      5. Distrobox for legacy Linux apps or as development containers.
      6. Appimage for portable apps found on the web.

      There is also package layering with rpm-ostree but it is advised to avoid using it if possible.

    • Updates & Rollbacks

      If a regression occurs then rollback to the previous deployment.

      • Updating Guide
      • Rollback System Updates
      • Rebasing to Other Images
      • bazzite-rollback-helper

    • Android Applications

      Run Android applications in a container using Waydroid!

      • Launch anything from productivity software to games.
      • Support for the Google Play Store and F-Droid.

    • Contributing

      One of the strengths of Bazzite (inherited from Universal Blue) is how easy is to contribute.

      • Something seems broken? You might want to report a bug.
      • Editing current documentation and adding translations are also appreciated.
